prompt:
Run a full CUAD-style clause review of the EXECUTED master services agreement between the analytics vendor and the freight client, for matter legal_matters_001. Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): ip_ownership_assignment, no_solicit_of_employees, insurance, audit_rights, termination_for_convenience, post_termination_services, cap_on_liability, uncapped_liability, anti_assignment, governing_law, most_favored_nation, exclusivity, minimum_commitment, non_compete, source_code_escrow. For each category present in the executed agreement, file one record with notes_create for legal_matters_001. Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
